ways.label: Tasman Glacier View Track, from Tasman Valley car park to the viewpoint

end.name: Tasman Glacier View viewpoint
end.quote: The viewpoint is at the top of a rocky wall of glacial debris, called ‘moraine’.

evidence: From Tasman Valley car park, follow the signposted gravel track to Tasman Glacier View.
The viewpoint is at the top of a rocky wall of glacial debris, called ‘moraine’.
Return to the car park the same way you came.

doubts: The start is the Tasman Valley car park, taken as road end F1, the only road end on Tasman Valley Road. That feature is labelled as where the Ball Hut Route meets Tasman Valley Road, not this track, so the ref is a judgment. The side trip's departure point is only 'the main track' and is not a named place, so from is null.
